title: Two days in Da Nang
summary: The river and My Khe on the first day. Son Tra and the Marble Mountains on the second, with Hoi An still an easy ride if the hills are enough.

days.title: Day 1 — River and beach
days.body: Cham Museum in the morning, mi Quang for lunch, then My Khe. Stay on the sand if the swim is the point.

days.title: Day 2 — Peninsula and the hills
days.body: Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra, then the Marble Mountains on the road toward Hoi An.

stops.name: Mi Quang
stops.note: Lunch between the museum and the beach.

stops.name: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra
stops.note: Day two. The ride is part of the visit.

stops.name: Marble Mountains
stops.note: On the way toward Hoi An. Skip it if Son Tra used the day.

seoDescription: A two-day Da Nang plan: the Cham Museum, My Khe, Son Tra, and the Marble Mountains on the way toward Hoi An.
